categories.main_business_segments: Beijing New Building Materials Public Limited Company (BNBM) operates primarily in three segments: lightweight building materials (mainly gypsum boards and steel studs), waterproof building materials, and coatings. The company produces and sells gypsum boards, steel studs, waterproof membranes, waterproof coatings, and various types of architectural and industrial coatings. It also engages in related construction materials and services, including integrated home decoration systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: BNBM utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies including high-speed intelligent gypsum board production lines, low-carbon and energy-efficient production processes, and innovative material formulations such as aerogel composite gypsum boards and antibacterial gypsum-based materials. The company emphasizes digital transformation and smart factory construction to enhance production efficiency and product quality. It also invests in R&D for high-performance waterproof materials and specialty coatings, leveraging national technology centers and expert workstations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers include real estate developers, public and commercial building contractors, home decoration companies, and retail consumers in the construction and renovation sectors. Its gypsum boards are widely used in office buildings, hotels, stadiums, industrial plants, and residential buildings. The waterproof and coating products serve infrastructure, transportation, industrial, and residential markets. The company also targets emerging international markets in Southeast Asia, Central Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and Eastern Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: BNBM operates extensively across China with production bases and sales networks covering northern, southern, and western regions. It has established subsidiaries and production facilities in Tanzania, Uzbekistan, Thailand, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and other emerging international markets. The company is actively expanding its global footprint focusing on Asia, Africa, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: BNBM operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the building materials supply chain. It manufactures core building materials such as gypsum boards, steel studs, waterproof membranes, and coatings, and supplies these products directly to construction companies, developers, and end consumers. The company also integrates upstream raw material sourcing, including industrial by-product gypsum, and downstream services such as installation and renovation solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on green technology, quality life, and full lifecycle green building solutions. It pursues a 'one body, two wings, global layout' strategy to strengthen gypsum board and related products, expand waterproof and coating businesses, and accelerate international market expansion. R&D priorities include low-carbon manufacturing, smart digital factories, high-performance functional materials, and integrated home decoration systems. The company emphasizes innovation in product diversification, energy efficiency, and sustainable development.
categories.revenue_model: BNBM generates revenue mainly through product sales of gypsum boards, steel studs, waterproof materials, and coatings. Sales are conducted via a combination of direct sales and extensive dealer networks covering urban and rural markets. The company also earns income from construction and renovation services, licensing, and technology transfer. Investment income and government subsidies contribute marginally to overall revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: BNBM is the leading player in China's gypsum board industry with the largest market share domestically. It competes with international and domestic companies producing high-end, mid-range, and low-end building materials. The company holds a strong brand portfolio including 'Longpai', 'Taishan', and 'Mengpai', and maintains competitive advantages in technology, scale, and distribution. It is recognized as a national champion and innovation leader in the building materials sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, BNBM reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 25.82 billion, a 15.14% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.65 billion, up 3.49%. The company’s R&D investment reached RMB 1.06 billion, growing 11.19%. It maintains a strong asset base exceeding RMB 35 billion and continues to expand through acquisitions and capacity enhancements. The company’s financial performance reflects steady growth and solid cash flow generation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: BNBM emphasizes green technology and high-quality building materials that support energy efficiency, environmental sustainability, and superior performance. Its products offer advantages such as fire resistance, sound insulation, light weight, and economic benefits. The company differentiates itself through integrated product solutions, extensive R&D capabilities, and a comprehensive sales and service network. It also focuses on digital transformation and innovation to meet diverse customer needs from commercial to residential applications.
